## Recorded Finance obligations and cash

Ledger differences below compare that recorded amount with confirmed transfers minus linked refunds. They do not establish claim eligibility, payment readiness or closure. Claim balance_cents remains null without a separately supported current-revision authorization.

Native Finance rows have no claim-revision column. Arrival revision context identifies the source-observed revision at first delivery; it is not an explicit authorization binding, and redelivery never changes it. Adjustments/resolutions record obligation amounts rather than cash. Cancellation/retry events are not refunds or proof that an obligation is zero.
